components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Amber committing action: Importar run, Ver em 3D.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #ffbe55; border-radius: 6px; background: #ffbe55; color: #0b0e13; font: 800 13px 'Public Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ffcd7a; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined quiet action that turns amber on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #3a4254; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #e6e6e8; font: 600 13px 'Public Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #ffbe55; color: #ffbe55; }

components.name: Trail Poster Card
components.description: Real aerial photo with the route in amber; lifts on hover while siblings dim.
components.html: Free RideSanta Marta das Cortiças, Braga · Vermelha
components.css: .ds-poster { width: 260px; padding-bottom: 14px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #1f2430; border-radius: 8px; background: #151922; color: #e6e6e8; transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); } .ds-poster:hover { border-color: #ffbe55; transform: translateY(-4px) rotateX(3deg) scale(1.03); } .ds-poster-art { aspect-ratio: 16/9; background: #1f2430; } .ds-poster strong { display: block; padding: 12px 14px 0; font: 800 24px 'Big Shoulders Display', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-poster small { padding: 0 14px; color: #a4a9b3; }

components.name: Sector Tiles
components.description: Mint-tinted when gained, coral-tinted when lost; selected grows, siblings dim.
components.css: .ds-tiles { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-tile { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; width: 150px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: #e6e6e8; font: 800 15px 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-gain { background: rgba(111,214,160,.1); border: 1px solid rgba(111,214,160,.45); } .ds-gain strong { color: #6fd6a0; } .ds-lost { background: rgba(255,138,107,.08); border: 1px solid rgba(255,138,107,.4); opacity: .5; } .ds-lost strong { color: #ff8a6b; } .ds-selected { border-color: #ffbe55; transform: scale(1.05); }

components.name: 3D Gate Marker
components.description: S/1/2/3/F gate on the 3D terrain; jumps the replay there.
components.css: .ds-gate { width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 1px solid #e6e6e8; border-radius: 4px; background: #0b0e13; color: #fff; font: 800 15px 'Big Shoulders Display', sans-serif; } .ds-gate:hover { border-color: #ffbe55; color: #ffbe55; }

narrative.overview: Ghostline looks like a streaming catalogue where every title is a trail: a Night ground, each trail shown as a poster of its real aerial photo with the route in amber, and the run replayed as a 3D flight over the real relief. Amber is brand and action, mint is gain, coral is loss. Depth comes from photos, scrims and motion: the focused item grows while its siblings dim. It replaces the earlier Azulejo de Braga world.
keyCharacteristics: Dark world with hairline borders and 6-10px corners.
Real imagery on every trail: DGT orthophoto posters, Sentinel-2 3D drape.
Big Shoulders Display titles, Public Sans data, tabular figures.
Amber action, mint gain, coral loss on tiles, figures and the 3D trace.
Focus-grows, siblings-dim motion, all disabled under reduced motion.
